purpose: Intelligent multi-provider LLM routing that automatically selects the optimal model (free→paid escalation) based on task complexity, provider health, and cost constraints. Routes claude-* requests through oe-proxy which intercepts and routes: haiku→Groq free, sonnet→Groq70B/free, opus→Anthropic premium. Backed by Free-Way (port 8082, 72+ models) and fcc-8083 (port 8083, 71 models).
services: oe-proxy (PM2 online, port=4100) — intercepts claude-* requests
model_policy: FREE_FIRST: groq/llama → cohere → openrouter/nemotron → Haiku (paid) → Sonnet (premium). Circuit breaker quarantines failing providers.
startup: All proxy services auto-start via PM2; ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4100
validation: PASS: oe-proxy healthy, 21 providers tracked, freeway+fcc-8083 both responding
approval_gates: Nathan approval to add/remove providers or change routing policy
rollback: Set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL to direct Anthropic API; restart affected agents
kpi: Free model usage % / latency p95 / cost per 1M tokens / provider uptime
